# Aris Medical Solutions

> Aris Medical Solutions provides HIPAA Keeper™, a comprehensive compliance automation platform designed to help healthcare providers and business associates achieve and maintain HIPAA compliance through risk management, documentation, and training.

Aris Medical Solutions is a nationwide HIPAA compliance leader serving healthcare entities across all 50 states. The company specializes in simplifying complex regulatory requirements through their cloud-based HIPAA Keeper platform, which automates compliance workflows and documentation.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA Compliance
- HIPAA Keeper™
- Risk Management
- ePHI (Electronic Protected Health Information)
- HIPAA Security Rule
- HIPAA Privacy Rule
- Business Associates
- Covered Entities
- Administrative Safeguards
- Physical Safeguards
- Healthcare Security
- Compliance Documentation
- HIPAA Audit
- Patient Data Protection
- Office for Civil Rights (OCR)
